videos.caption: Driving the opening straight and first sweeping corners of the Tsukuba circuit in a road car, with the minimap, speed and gear readout on screen.

stills.alt: In-game view behind a white road car approaching a left-hand corner with red and white kerbs.
Chase camera on a white car in a long sweeping bend with trees and a clubhouse in the distance.
Apex Turismo title screen with the red emblem and the tagline The Real Driving Simulator.
Generated track map of the Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps with corner names and an elevation profile.
Generated track map of Suzuka Circuit with corner names and an elevation profile.

videos.caption: Driving a car along an endlessly generated road through rolling terrain, trees and blocky buildings, with a live minimap and speed readout.

stills.alt: Third-person view of a car on a two-lane road with double yellow centre line heading toward distant hills.
Car on a curving road climbing a grassy hill, speed and gear shown bottom left and a circular minimap bottom right.

videos.caption: Orbiting camera around a 3D point-cloud reconstruction of a lab produced from video frames.

A simulated 134 km/h delivery seen from behind the bowler in 4x slow motion, with ball detections in yellow, the fitted flight in blue and the fitted bounce as a red cross, then the estimates next to the simulator's truth.

stills.alt: Pitch map of the batter's end with length bands from yorker to too short, showing the estimated bounce as a red cross at 4.92 m and the true bounce as a black circle at 5.48 m for a synthetic delivery.
Virtual cricket club ground with a red-roofed clubhouse and fielders in blue.
Village scoreboard in front of a clubhouse showing total, wickets and overs, with picket fence and trees.
Close view of the stumps and painted crease lines on a dirt cricket pitch.
Top-down view of a cricket pitch with stumps at both ends on short green grass.

videos.caption: A 13 second cut from a scripted camera path through the game, rendered off screen without audio: the village from the river, the river and bridge, the waterfall, the village square with the bow, and a conversation with the elder.

stills.alt: Thatched round huts in a village clearing beside the river, with palms, forest and mountains behind.
A wooden rope-railed bridge crossing a green river toward a waterfall at the end of the valley.
Close view of the wooden bridge on posts over the river, with the waterfall in the distance.
The waterfall at dusk seen from above, falling over a stone weir into a misty pool among palms.
The waterfall seen from near the pool, with a leafy tree in the foreground and mountains behind.
A conversation in the village square: a crowned, armoured elder speaks and the dialogue box offers three replies, with villagers around.

videos.caption: The relighting viewer on the demo lab scene: baked appearance on the left, relit result on the right. The camera orbits, a warm sun is swept across the scene, then the right pane shows intrinsic albedo, baked irradiance and surface normals.

stills.alt: Split-view viewer on the demo lab scene, a mobile equipment cart in a blurry room. Baked appearance on the left, relit result on the right, with the control panel at far right.
The same scene with the right pane showing intrinsic albedo, the surface colour with the baked lighting removed, next to the baked view.
The same scene with the right pane showing surface normals as a colour map, next to the baked view.

videos.caption: AI-generated clip of a point of light expanding into a swirling, lightning-like explosion, with generated audio.
Top-down simulation of a ball leaving the bat while the nearest fielders compute intercept points and run to catch it across three field settings.

stills.alt: Top-down matplotlib field plot with the boundary circle, nine fielders in blue, a red ball and field-set buttons.

videos.caption: Walkthrough of the Content Studio dashboard in mock mode with sample data: the projects list, then a helicopter explainer project with its approval gates, research sources and quality report.

The approved helicopter example, rendered by the pipeline: a 13 second vertical explainer on why a pilot cuts power when the tail rotor fails, with synthesised narration and timed captions. Unmute for sound.

stills.alt: Dashboard pipeline view listing every production stage with its review state; Research and Script are done and Storyboard needs review, with a Mark reviewed button. A MOCK DATA banner is visible.
Dashboard research tab showing the core concept, 11 sources and 46 facts, with a sources table listing kind, reliability, link check and access date. A MOCK DATA banner is visible.

Dashboard quality control report from mock data showing 0 critical, 2 warnings, 31 passed and 1 skipped (34 checks), with an all-checks list of measured and expected values. A MOCK DATA banner is visible.

videos.caption: The champion of one MAP-Elites run (condition D, seed 2) at each generation where it changed, walking on flat ground in MuJoCo, re-simulated from the saved genomes. It is one run chosen because its champion changed four times, not the best of the experiment.

stills.alt: Two scatter plots of fitness on training terrain against fitness on held-out terrain, one point per seed for the four conditions. Nearly all points sit on or below the line where the two are equal, and the morphology-only points are highest.
Best training fitness against simulations used for the four conditions. Morphology-only starts near 0.6 because it uses the hand-designed gait, while the others start near zero.
Nine creatures from one MAP-Elites archive in a three by three grid, each labelled with body plan, gait, frequency, fitness, speed and efficiency. Several are weak or tipped over on purpose.
Champion of the best morphology-only run, a six-legged walker with round feet.
Best joint-evolution champion, a six-legged metachronal walker.
Best joint MAP-Elites champion, a six-legged walker.
Best controller-only champion on the fixed reference quadruped body.

videos.caption: Compare view on a synthetic test clip: the left half of the ball uses a fixed studio light, the right half uses Lumina's estimate. First a camera pan over a hilltop, then a still camera while the environment turns and the light changes. The picture is a rendered panorama, not a real room.

stills.alt: Compare view during the pan clip: a ball over a hilltop scene, the left half lit by a fixed studio light and the right half by Lumina's estimate.
Compare view with the sun behind the ball: the Lumina half has gone dark while the fixed-light half stays neutral.
Compare view with the light on the camera side: the Lumina half is bright and warm while the fixed-light half stays neutral.
